info.title: NAS Console Server API
info.description: Implementation contract only. Existing server deployment/training has not been verified. Candidate row id is evaluation_id; candidate_id is stable across promotions. Demonstration values are not measured results.

servers.description: Replace with actual HTTPS endpoint; exact frontend origin CORS allowlist required

200.description: Bearer-authenticated fetch SSE, at-least-once delivery; event id=seq; JSON data uses Event schema. Reconnect with cursor.
Authorized artifact bytes; MIME/SHA headers or short-lived signed-url response. Never accepts arbitrary filesystem paths.
Immutable experiment export bundle with provenance, metrics, lineage, cost ledger and manifests

BearerAuth.description: Keep token in browser memory only; fetch SSE with Authorization header; no URL/localStorage/export persistence

dataset_yaml.description: Absolute Linux server path; existence and allowlist checked by server, not by browser

execution_mode.description: Resolved explicitly; absent pilot calibration implies PILOT, not formal completed registered search.

Protocol.description: Attachment nas-policy-design/1.0 body retained as requested provenance; console extension adds web settings. Validate creates immutable actual resolved policy with verified backend/path/budget and declared execution mode. Original DESIGN_EXAMPLE_NOT_EXECUTABLE is not treated as executable by itself.

id.description: Immutable evaluation_id, unique per point and device/rung/checkpoint; provisional row is mutable until evaluation committed

candidate_id.description: Stable architecture candidate ID, retained across promotion

evaluation_hash.description: Common evaluator protocol/split/metric signature; excludes candidate/checkpoint to support cohort curves. Individual measurement uses id and checkpoint hash.

candidate_status.description: Mutable architecture candidate state; measurement row status remains EVALUATED after its immutable commit.

Generation.description: Complete only when planning_closed=true and pending_count=0. Server semantically enforces evaluated_count+failed_count+not_admitted_count+pending_count=planned_count. No representative/line when no valid measured evaluation exists.

ga_billed_gpu_seconds.description: Measured GPU seconds; null/absent until available

x-execution-invariants: Freeze actual resolved protocol and source hashes before run; attachments are design examples.
One architecture candidate may produce many immutable evaluation rows by rung/device/objective.
Plot only finite completed metrics within same fidelity/objective/evaluation/device/precision/input/timing group.
Send generation.completed after planned set closes and pending_count is zero; failures are not points.
Same idempotency key plus same payload reuses run; changed payload conflicts.
Use full-state resume at fixed global horizon; generation restore alone is insufficient.
Source-rung weights gate promotion; passing eligibility is distinct from budget admission.
IndependentRandom sampler prior never consumes observed fitness.
GT/TP/FN/FP artifacts are from same sample and evaluation with deterministic matching.
Track physical GPU and arm-equivalent billed cost separately.
Final retraining/test and search results are separate.
EVALUATED cohort fields protocol_hash/batch/resolved_input_shape/search_seed are mandatory. evaluation_hash excludes per-candidate checkpoints. Complete generation counts must sum to planned_count.
Run uses Validate.resolved and resolved protocol_hash; without calibration, actual execution is explicitly PILOT. Original design example provenance remains unchanged.
